hypothesis: Allow actual uncommitted cash and aggregate stop-risk to finance other already-qualified opportunities, without canceling existing economic intentions or adding a fixed alternative position-count parameter. Test whether otherwise stranded resources diversify profitable participation rather than merely magnify losses.
control: observed_admission_completion.Owner with unchanged parameters and Config, preserving the complete retained control account
treatment: First obtain the unchanged parent's close decision. Do nothing if its risk cap is zero, any target reduces actual inventory, any unresolved economic ceiling or exit obligation remains, or actual positions do not already occupy the parent's two slots. Reserve every parent purchase. Among original ready/entry/positive-score/no-exit names that are actually unheld, not readmission-blocked, and have no parent purchase, rank by the unchanged score and symbol tie-break. For each, allocate only the minimum of remaining 99%-actual-cash authority, gross exposure slack, aggregate mark-to-stop risk slack divided by the new admission's risk fraction, original single-name slack and original sector slack. Require the unchanged 1%-NAV new-order materiality. Update pending admission stops and reserve every addition before considering the next name. There is no replacement position-count limit: cash, risk, concentration, eligibility and materiality determine the funded count. Retain original held-addition breakout requirements and actual held units. Never assume any sale proceeds, cancel protection, or spend pending buys twice.
